thread:
Maya: FYI dropping the latest company-level slate for Q3/Q4. Link: https://redwood.design/drive/company-slate-v3 — I highlighted the risk anchors and proposed launch acceptance checklist. We need buy-in from execs + eng on scope tonight.

Liam: skimmed — main flag is Dedicated latency work. If we keep `dedicated autoscale` as a must-have we need +2 GPUs of capacity or defer parity to Q4.

Maya: noted. Proposal: make Dedicated autoscale a canary must-have for top 10 customers; full parity is T2 (nice-to-have). That lets us ship early. Thoughts?

Sam: agree with the staged approach. Can we attach an SLA commitment only for Dedicated GA customers? don't promise infra we can't guarantee.

Ana: UX note — the onboarding flow for Dedicated assumes auto-provisioning. If we stage autoscale we should show an "expected capabilities" banner. Small copy change, low lift.

Ben: on metrics, suggest replacing raw P50 latency with P99 tail and 95th cost-per-1k-tokens. Those map better to customer outcomes.

Priya: customer asks we got from Acme and Luma — both push for streaming + function calling. Are we treating function-calling as must-have? It's in the draft but ambiguous.

Maya: good catch. I think function-calling = must-have for hosted API, nice-to-have for Dedicated GA. That gives teams time to validate toolchains.

Liam: implementation note: function-calling requires augment in our runtime to support structured streaming + call args serialization. ETA 3 sprints for core infra team. If we mark it must-have for Hosted we must prioritize that in sprint planning.

Sam: prioritize hosted path first. It's where the PLG motion converts. Dedicated can follow.

Maya: updated the doc inline — changed `function-calling` row to: Hosted=Must, Dedicated=CanaryMust. Also added acceptance tests.

Ben: acceptance tests look good but leave room for a synthetic latency regression threshold. Add `latency_regression_delta <= 10%` as a stop condition.

Maya: added. Also adding rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automatic rollback on regressions.

Priya: do we have an owner for the rollout orchestration? Need someone from eng-platform + SRE to sign off. @Liam can you nominate?

Liam: i'll own the orchestration work. Eng-platform + SRE will pair.

Ana: small design ask — can we include a banner component `beta` that we can toggle via feature flag for canary customers? simple and unblock design.

Maya: yes, feature-flagged banner is perfect.

Sam: last big risk is QA coverage for customer-driven prompts. We should lock a prompt-set and evaluation harness before ship to catch regressions. Who owns evals?

Ben: Research/ML can own prompt-set curation — i'll coordinate with @Maya and @Priya to seed with top customer flows. Add eval pass as a gating check.

Maya: putting `eval-suite` as a hard gate for GA. Draft checklist in the doc: ```
- Acceptance smoke (endpoint up, auth, basic generation)
- Function-calling integration tests (hosted)
- Canary rollout plan defined
- Eval-suite pass (regression delta <= thresholds)
- Observability dashboards live (cost, tail latency, errors)
- UX banner & docs updated
```

Liam: one more: dependency on quantization libs for cost targets. Mark that as risk-anchor; if not ready, we revert to larger instance types and update cost forecast.

Maya: added risk-anchor: `quant-lib delay => cost uplift`. Finance will need the updated forecast.

Sam: okay — we're close. I need explicit signoff line from Eng, Product, Research, and Design. Can each lead drop an emoji or short note? want to finalize by EOD.

Liam: Eng sign-off :thumbsup: will deliver orchestration + infra tickets.

Ben: Research sign-off :white_check_mark: will deliver eval-suite and prompt-set.

Ana: Design sign-off :eyes: will ship banner copy + onboarding tweaks by tomorrow lunchtime.

Maya: Product sign-off :rocket: locking the slate and sending to finance for run-rate.

Sam: Exec note: :thumbsup: — after finance update and SRE acknowledges runbook, consider this OKR draft ratified.

OkrsBot: Reminder scheduled: "OKR slate final sign-off" at 18:00 today. Use `/confirm-slate` to mark complete.

Maya: thanks everyone — i'll update the doc and post final link once finance numbers are in. If any objections, drop here before 17:00.

Priya: no objections from customer-success side. I'll prep customer comms for canary cohort.

Liam: creating infra tickets now, will ping channel when done.

Maya: closing loop — tagging this thread as the final pass for exec review. Appreciate the quick turn. :tada:
